EmailTemplate.description: CL Only - Introduce new service team - schedule strategy meeting with new team
EmailTemplate.name: CL-QTP Introduction to New Service Team After Transfer
EmailTemplate.subject: New Service Team Introduction Service Strategy Meeting Invitation
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
CC all new service team members Attach new client contact sheet
Good morning/afternoon [client name]
We are excited to be working with you; I've attached a contact sheet with your new service team's contact information. We've met with [previous service team name(s)] to understand your business, goals, and projects worked on to date.
I'd like to schedule time to meet your team and discuss what is on the horizon for the remainder of [current year] and also look forward to [following year] and beyond.
Are you available on [insert date and time] for approximately 60-90 minutes? If no please suggest alternate times and I'll send a calendar invitation.
We thank you in advance for forwarding this on to anyone else in your organization who should be aware of a service team change.
We look forward to hearing from you soon and look forward to our partnership.
[signature]
